summary: Institutional-grade autonomous AI options trading terminal for defined-risk credit spreads on Alpaca paper account ($100k). High-density Bloomberg Noir meets modern quantitative hedge-fund observability: LLM reasoning gating layer, deterministic risk engine, live payoff diagrams, multi-leg spreads matrix, interactive equity curve, trade history, live agent cycle trigger, and an interactive MCP-style 'Ask the Agent' intelligence panel.

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight font-sans text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3_card_title: text-sm font-semibold tracking-normal uppercase text-slate-400 font-mono

anti_ai_slop: No generic purple centered cards or Vercel clones.
High-density grid borders: 1px subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) with sharp 4px to 6px radii.
Every metric has its context: 24h delta, allocation percentage, strike bounds, and Alpaca order ID.
Never use pure black or low-contrast text. Always provide explicit contrast tags and font-mono for all financial numbers.
Visual badge hierarchy for credit spread types: Put Credit Spread (Emerald / Bullish), Call Credit Spread (Rose / Bearish), Iron Condor (Cyan / Range-Bound).

interactive_elements.run_cycle_button: Tactical pill or sharp button with animated pulsing radar ping when agent cycle is executing.
interactive_elements.risk_gate_badge: Deterministic Approval/Rejection tag with visual checklist (Delta <= 0.20, Max Risk <= $2,500, Min Credit >= 30%, DTE 0-3 days, Buying Power buffer >= 25%).
interactive_elements.reasoning_feed: Chronological audit trail showing LLM structured JSON verdicts alongside deterministic gate validations.
interactive_elements.payoff_visualizer: Interactive miniature multi-leg payoff graph showing breakeven points, max profit, and max risk for active positions.

header.market_status: NYSE / NASDAQ: OPEN (or CLOSED with countdown)

layout_architecture.grid_structure: 4-column responsive operational grid (Mode B - High Density Grid)

sections.description: 4-widget top ribbon: Total Equity ($104,820.50), Day P&L (+$1,450.00 / +1.40%), Open Risk ($4,800 / 4.58% cap), Available Buying Power ($87,420.00), Win Rate (78.4% / 37 Trades).
Left 8 cols: Equity Growth Curve & Intraday P&L vs SPY benchmark + Active Positions Table. Right 4 cols: Agent Live LLM Decision Engine + 'Ask the Agent' MCP Interactive Panel.

Dense tabular matrix of open multi-leg spreads (Underlying, Strategy, Legs [e.g. SPY +500P/-502P], DTE, Entry Credit, Mark, Unrealized P&L $, P&L %, TP Target, Stop Loss, Risk Gate Score, Quick Actions [Close / Payoff Modal]).
Tabbed view: (1) LLM Reasoning Stream & Verdicts, (2) Deterministic Risk Gate Audit (PASS/FAIL telemetry), (3) Trade Execution History, (4) Risk Parameters Config.
MCP-style conversational drawer/card allowing operator to ask 'Why did you enter SPY 505/510 call spread?', 'What is our current portfolio delta?', 'Simulate a 2% SPY drop'.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.general: Build clean, modular, error-resilient JavaScript (.js/.jsx) components for React. Dark mode by default with Tailwind classes. No unstyled HTML forms; use Lucide-react icons. Provide complete simulated state with Alpaca paper mechanics and interactive state triggers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mock_data_integrity: Provide realistic credit spread data on SPY, QQQ, IWM, NVDA, AAPL, TSLA with actual options leg math (Short strike, Long strike, Credit collected, Max risk = width - credit, DTE 0-3 days).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.state_actions: Operators can manually trigger simulated agent cycles, configure risk engine sliders, ask custom queries to Claude 4.6 in the MCP chat panel, close active positions, and inspect multi-leg payoff diagrams.
